thread:
Olivia Park: Idea — tie the weekly newsletter to the benchmark narrative. Short spotlight in the newsletter (tile + CTA) that feeds a 3-email mini-drip for engaged readers. Goal: drive demo starts or 5-min benchmark view. Thoughts?
Sam Bennett: Nice. Use the newsletter as the top-of-funnel nudge. Tile links should include `utm_campaign=news_bench_series` and a snippet param for personalization.
Hannah Lee: Proposed drip: Email A (stat-driven snapshot), Email B (short customer story), Email C (invite to 10-min live walkthrough or on-demand clip). Send cadence: 0, 3, 8 days.
Ravi Singh: Segments: newsletter-clickers (tile click), new-signups <7d, trial-users. Each path gets a tailored CTA: view clip, start sandbox, book quick demo.
Olivia Park: A/B test subject line on Email A for newsletter-clickers: Variant 1 = stat-first, Variant 2 = narrative hook. Run 50/50.
Hannah Lee: Metrics: open, click, watch_rate (`bench_clip_watched`), sandbox_start. Add conversion window 14 days. Also capture `source=newsletter` in lead props.
Sam Bennett: Deliverability: keep tile image as remote hosted 1x1 thumbnail, include plain-text fallback. Avoid >150KB payload. Use single CTA button per email.
Ravi Singh: Quick automation rules:
```
- If click from enterprise domain -> tag lead enterprise & fire SDR webhook
- If watch_rate >50% -> send trial-invite (Email C alt)
- If click but no watch -> send reminder at Day 5 with 30s clip
```
Olivia Park: Ops checklist:
```
- Build 3 responsive templates with modular blocks
- Add merge keys: {{first_name}}, {{top_metric}}, {{cta_label}}
- Create segment export: newsletter_clickers, new_signups_7d, trial_users
- Wire UTMs and `bench_clip_watched` webhook
- QA staging send to 100 internal (desktop + mobile)
- Schedule dry-run then ramp based on metrics
```
Hannah Lee: I'll draft copy and two subject variants by EOD Wednesday. Sam, can you confirm image hosting and size limit?
Sam Bennett: Confirmed. Hosting on CDN with signed URLs. I'll optimize thumbnails to <18KB and provide links.
Ravi Singh: send-tool commands for staging dry-run:
```
send-tool create-campaign --name "news-bench-series" --from "Olivia <olivia@redwood.ai>"
send-tool import-segment --file segments/newsletter_clickers.csv --as staging-list
send-tool schedule --campaign news-bench-series --dry-run --list staging-list --at "2025-01-14T09:00:00-07:00"
```
mailer-bot: Dry-run queued for 2025-01-14 09:00 PT to staging-list. Reminder 20m prior.
Olivia Park: Nice. After dry-run we'll check opens, clicks, and watch webhook. If Email A variant stat-first wins by >3% open lift, we'll roll that subject to remaining cohorts. Otherwise iterate copy.
Hannah Lee: Also adding a 1-click poll in Email C footer: "Which part was most useful? [Cost][Latency][Integration]" to refine next segmenting. Poll links will update `preference_tag`.
Sam Bennett: Sounds good. I'll push templates and run inbox previews Friday morning. Ravi will wire the webhooks. We'll sync post dry-run to decide ramp. :rocket:
